newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINES' SMART IPO TO FOCUS ON DOMESTIC MARKET.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINES' SMART IPO TO FOCUS ON DOMESTIC MARKET.

text.p: Philippines' Smart Communications Inc is focusing its initial public offering (IPO) on the domestic market, officials from parent Metro Pacific Corp said on Monday.
"The Smart IPO will be principally for the local investors," MPC director Seumas Gallacher told reporters.
He said Smart will be counting on its strong following in the country to buy the $150 million to $175 million worth of shares which it plans to list in late September or early October.
Gallacher said the proceeds will be enough to cover capital expenses in the coming months.
The company has earmarked a total of 16 billion pesos in 1997 and 1998 for both cellular and fixed line expenditures.
The international offering has been deferred after its underwriting team advised them of the poor appetite among foreign fund managers for telecom issues.
Gallacher said the foreign tranche will be sold in another offering later after Smart share prices are set in the local equities market.

Smart, the country's biggest cellular phone company, has postponed its IPO twice due to the poor overall market condition and negative sentiment on the telecom sector after mobile phone firms became victims of fraud calls last year.
Metro Pacific chairman Manuel Pangilinan said the IPO roadshow is scheduled in the first week of September.
"We anticipate the listing to take place towards the end of September or early October," he said.
